newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CAPELLO SAYS NO TO ITALIAN JOB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAPELLO SAYS NO TO ITALIAN JOB.

text.p: Real Madrid coach Fabio Capello said on Monday he would not consider taking over as manager of the Italian national team from Arrigo Sacchi, who has returned to troubled giants AC Milan.

"Right now the Real Madrid bench is most important for me," said Capello, who moved to Spain from AC Milan at the end of last season "(The job of national coach) is an aspiration that I will have within three or four years."
